BEFORE YOU BEGIN

A few things you might be wondering.

About building online stores with Atomic.

Is there a storefront template?

Yes. Atomic’s Storefront template includes a product catalogue, categories, cart and checkout screens, order history, and a shop-manager view. It opens with sample data so you can explore the flow before making it your own.

Does a checkout screen mean I can accept live payments?

No. An order or checkout flow is separate from payment processing. Taking money requires a payment provider, the appropriate integration, and end-to-end testing. Atomic does not promise a ready-made payment integration here.

Can customers have accounts and order history?

Yes, these are part of the Storefront template. The proposed Free plan includes a backend, database, and authentication for one app; Builder and Pro include them for every app. Test customer access to order records before publishing.

What should I replace before launch?

Replace placeholder text and images, remove sample products and records, and verify access rules for customer and staff data. Preview accounts are for testing and are not published with your app.
